footnotes: The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 40-F for fiscal years ended Oct 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 18.4% to C$67.8B in fiscal 2025 (ended Oct 31, 2025). Operating income rose 2.1× to C$23.9B, a 35.3% margin.
Net income rose 2.3× to C$20.5B, or C$11.56 per share. Operating cash flow was −C$69.6B and free cash flow −C$69.6B, versus C$54.9B; TD Bank returned C$7.7B through dividends.
watch: Cash ended the year at C$116.9B.
sources: The Toronto-Dominion Bank Form 40-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
